# SPOROTRICHOSIS

Sporotrichosis occurs most often in people who have had significant outdoor exposure to soil. In immunocompetent people, disease is usually limited to the skin. In people with decreased host defenses (eg, HIV/AIDS, alcoholism, diabetes mellitus, or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) sporotrichosis often disseminates to bones, joints, or lungs.

Consult Infectious Diseases or Dermatology.

Kaufman CA Clin Infect Dis 2000, 30: 684
